products.name: 5/8-inch slip-on tub diverter spout, chrome
products.headline: 5/8 in OD slip-on
products.summary: One genuine American Standard 022650-0020A polished-chrome tub spout with a pull-up shower diverter. It slips onto 5/8-inch outside-diameter copper tubing and projects 5.688 inches from the finished wall. It is not a threaded IPS or NPT spout, so confirm the bare tube diameter and projection before ordering.

specs.name: Documented trim family
specs.value: American Standard Colony Soft 2- and 3-handle bath/shower trim

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Threaded IPS or NPT nipples, 3/4-inch copper tube, or non-chrome finish matching

faqs.q: Will this tub spout screw onto a threaded nipple?
faqs.a: No. Model 022650-0020A is a slip-on spout for smooth 5/8-inch outside-diameter copper tubing.

faqs.q: Does a 1/2-inch copper pipe measure 1/2 inch across?
faqs.a: No. Standard nominal 1/2-inch copper tubing has a 5/8-inch outside diameter, which is the dimension this spout fits.

faqs.q: How far does the spout project from the wall?
faqs.a: The published projection is 5.688 inches, or 144 millimeters, from the finished wall.

faqs.q: Does this spout divert water to a shower head?
faqs.a: Yes. It has a pull-up diverter on the nose.

faqs.q: Is this the brushed-nickel version?
faqs.a: No. MPN 022650-0020A is polished chrome.

products.name: Pennington 20-1/4-inch drop-in sink, white, single hole
products.headline: 20-1/4 × 17-1/2 in
products.summary: One genuine white KOHLER Pennington K-2196-1-0 oval drop-in bathroom sink with a single faucet hole and overflow. Its outside footprint is 20-1/4 by 17-1/2 inches, but countertop fit must be established with the included KOHLER 1002970-7 cutout template rather than the nominal outside dimensions. This is not the 4-inch centerset, 8-inch widespread, biscuit, or almond variant.

specs.name: Cutout method
specs.value: Use current KOHLER template 1002970-7; do not cut from nominal dimensions

specs.name: Not this variant
specs.value: K-2196-4 centerset, K-2196-8 widespread, biscuit, almond, black, dune or ice-grey sink

faqs.q: Will this replace any oval sink that is about 20 inches wide?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Compare the existing countertop opening with the current KOHLER 1002970-7 template; outside dimensions alone do not establish fit.

faqs.q: What faucet drilling does K-2196-1-0 have?
faqs.a: One 1-3/8-inch faucet hole. It is not drilled for a 4-inch centerset or an 8-inch widespread faucet.

faqs.q: Does this sink have an overflow?
faqs.a: Yes. This exact white single-hole variant includes an overflow passage.

faqs.q: What size drain does it accept?
faqs.a: The published drain-hole diameter is 1-3/4 inches. The drain assembly is not included.

faqs.q: Is the countertop cutout 20-1/4 by 17-1/2 inches?
faqs.a: No. Those are nominal exterior dimensions. Use the included KOHLER cutout template.

products.name: Cimarron 2-inch canister flush-valve kit
products.headline: K-4369 and K-4418 tanks
products.fit: 3 in canister · 2 in outlet · gasket included
products.summary: One genuine KOHLER 1188998 complete canister flush-valve kit for Cimarron toilet tanks K-4369 and K-4418. The assembly uses a 3-inch canister over a 2-inch outlet and includes the tank-to-bowl gasket. Confirm the tank number molded or stamped inside the rear tank wall; the toilet collection name or bowl number alone does not establish fit.

specs.name: Included
specs.value: Complete canister assembly and tank-to-bowl gasket

specs.name: Tank identification location
specs.value: Inside rear wall of toilet tank

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Unlisted KOHLER tanks, flapper-style valves, 3-inch outlets, or seal-only repair when only GP1059291 is needed

faqs.q: Will KOHLER 1188998 fit every Cimarron toilet?
faqs.a: No. The documented tank models are K-4369 and K-4418. Read the number inside the rear tank wall before ordering.

faqs.q: Is this a two-inch or three-inch flush valve?
faqs.a: It has a 3-inch canister and a 2-inch outlet. Both measurements matter.

faqs.q: Does the kit include the tank-to-bowl gasket?
faqs.a: Yes. This is the complete canister assembly with the gasket.

faqs.q: Can I identify fit from the bowl model?
faqs.a: No. Use the tank model number, because bowls and tanks can be paired or replaced separately.

faqs.q: Do I need this kit if only the canister seal leaks?
faqs.a: Possibly not. For a seal-only repair, compare your toilet with KOHLER GP1059291 before replacing the complete valve.

products.name: RVS50 room-side bathroom exhaust fan
products.headline: 7-1/4 × 7-1/2 in opening
products.summary: One ReVent RVS50 room-side bathroom exhaust fan for a measured 7-1/4 by 7-1/2-inch ceiling or wall opening with at least 4-3/8 inches of housing depth and a 4-inch exhaust duct. It moves 50 CFM for bathrooms up to about 50 square feet and uses a 9-3/4-inch square shield. This exact variant is not the lower-cost RVP50ES or the larger RVS110.

specs.name: Installation
specs.value: Room-side ceiling or wall installation; no attic access required

specs.name: Not this model
specs.value: RVP50ES, RVS110, lighted RVL50 or humidity-sensing RVSH50

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Openings or cavities smaller than the stated housing, or direct 3-inch duct connection without an approved transition

faqs.q: What ceiling opening does the ReVent RVS50 need?
faqs.a: Measure for a 7-1/4 by 7-1/2-inch opening and at least 4-3/8 inches of housing depth.

faqs.q: Is the 9-3/4-inch shield the fan housing size?
faqs.a: No. The shield is 9-3/4 inches square; the housing and opening are smaller at 7-1/4 by 7-1/2 inches.

faqs.q: What duct size fits the RVS50?
faqs.a: It is specified for a 4-inch exhaust duct.

faqs.q: Does this fan require attic access?
faqs.a: No. Its SheetLock system supports installation from the room side.

faqs.q: Can it ventilate a 100-square-foot bathroom?
faqs.a: No. This exact variant is rated at 50 CFM for rooms up to about 50 square feet; choose a correctly sized larger model.

faqs.q: Can it be installed over a bathtub or shower?
faqs.a: Yes, only when installed according to the instructions on a GFCI-protected circuit.

products.name: Universal 2-inch tank-to-bowl gasket
products.headline: 2 in flush valves
products.fit: Close-coupled toilets · round or hex nut · not Gerber
products.summary: One Fluidmaster 6100 sponge-rubber tank-to-bowl gasket for most close-coupled toilets with a 2-inch flush valve and a round or hex-shaped flush-valve nut. The word universal does not include 3-inch flush valves or Gerber toilets, and this package contains the gasket only, without tank bolts or other mounting hardware.

specs.name: Not for
specs.value: Gerber toilets, 3-inch flush valves, one-piece toilets, or installations requiring included bolts

faqs.q: Does Fluidmaster 6100 fit a 3-inch flush valve?
faqs.a: No. Model 6100 is for 2-inch flush-valve toilets.

faqs.q: Does universal mean it fits Gerber toilets?
faqs.a: No. Fluidmaster explicitly excludes Gerber toilets from this gasket's fit.

faqs.q: Are tank bolts included?
faqs.a: No. This package contains one gasket only; mounting hardware is sold separately.

faqs.q: What toilet style does it fit?
faqs.a: It fits most close-coupled two-piece toilets with a 2-inch flush valve and a round or hex-shaped flush-valve nut.

faqs.q: How do I verify the flush-valve size?
faqs.a: Turn off the water, separate the tank only if safe to do so, and identify the valve outlet or existing gasket size. Do not choose from brand name alone.
